title: Music Everywhere with New Music
description: All music plays without biome restrictions plus enjoy the newest Minecraft music in previous updates!
body:
A simple resource pack that takes all the Minecraft music from creative mode, the main menu, and other specific biomes (e.g. update Aquatic underwater only music) and allows all of it to play in both creative and survival without biome or mode restrictions. I have also added most of the new Minecraft music that was released after 1.20.1 (i.e. Tricky Trials and Chase the Clouds updates) to this pack so that you can enjoy the new Minecraft songs in 1.20.1-6 without restriction as well!

Note, the Nether and End music will only play in those respective dimensions. However, the couple of songs in the Nether that would only play in the Soul Sand Valley and Crimson Forest will now also play without biome restrictions when in the Nether.
